title: Power Mean Limit: lim_{r→0} M_r = GM (Geometric Mean as a Limit)

problemStatement.formal: Filter.Tendsto (fun r => (∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ^ r) ^ (1 / r)) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds (∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i))
problemStatement.plain: lim_{r→0} M_r(z,w) = GM(z,w) where M_r = (∑ wᵢzᵢ^r)^(1/r) and GM = ∏ zᵢ^wᵢ.
